Would you like to work in a flower paradise? 💐 Join us as a warehouse worker in the flower department at Royal FloraHolland! In this role, you will sort flowers and place them on carts. You will start earning € 17.98 per hour straight away (including holiday pay)! You also have a chance to get a permanent contract. And... you get to take a bunch of flowers home every month. YES! 🌻 Read on quickly. 👇

What we offer
- Earn € 17.98 per hour right from the start!
- Morning shifts – free afternoons/evenings!
- A chance to get a contract with Royal Flora!
- Pick-up service provided by Flora in the morning!
- Public transport costs are fully reimbursed!
- A free bunch of flowers to take home every month!

Who you are
As a warehouse worker at Royal Flora Holland, you meet the following requirements:

- You are 18 years or older (due to working hours);
- You are available on weekdays from 06:00 AM - 02.00 PM;
- You are available from Monday to Friday;
- You are able to work in Aalsmeer;
- You speak Dutch or English;
- Your height is at least 165 cm;
- You are available for at least 4 months.

What will you do
As a warehouse worker at Royal FloraHolland, you make sure the right flowers reach the right customer! You will organize the racks according to the customer's orders. Using your cart, you will collect the correct flowers from the warehouse. 💪 During your training period, you will get plenty of time to master this process. On top of that, a dedicated training team will be there to guide you! 🎉

Where will you work
Royal FloraHolland has been bringing growers and buyers together for over 100 years. But they cannot do this without you as a warehouse worker! ✨ You will join a great team with nice colleagues. But that's not all! You can regularly enjoy a beautiful bouquet of flowers for your home. 💐

At Royal FloraHolland, you can work throughout the week. You start at 06:00 AM and usually finish around 02:00 PM. Royal FloraHolland also offers various training opport

Are you a hands-on professional with a keen eye for order, safety, and efficiency? As a Logistics Operator, you ensure that all raw materials, packaging supplies, and finished products are delivered to the right place at the right time. Working independently in a dynamic production environment, you are the crucial link between the warehouse and the production lines. With a salary of up to €3,500 per month including shift allowance in a 3-shift system, you are also well rewarded for your efforts!

Functieomschrijving:
As a Logistics Operator, you will operate the forklift and carry out a variety of logistics tasks, including:
• Supplying and removing raw and auxiliary materials as well as finished products from the production lines.
• Moving materials between the warehouse, loading docks, and production department.
• Stacking pallets and processing waste streams.
• Completing transport and waste registration forms in line with procedures.
• Cleaning and maintaining logistics tools and equipment.
• Identifying bottlenecks and proposing improvements.

Functievereisten:
You are the right candidate if you:
• Have an MBO-level background.
• Bring experience in logistics or production processes (a plus).
• Hold a valid forklift license, or are willing to obtain one.
• Are flexible, stress-resistant, and take responsibility.
• Have a good command of the English language.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:
In return for your commitment as a Logistics Operator, you will receive:
• A gross monthly salary of up to €3,500 including shift allowance.
• An independent role in a healthy, modern production company.
• Opportunities for internal growth toward Coordinator or Team Leader positions.
• A dedicated team with short communication lines.
Ready to become the driving force of this factory's logistics? Apply now and take your career to the next level!

Do you get energized by helping people? Are you a good listener and do you work meticulously? Do you also enjoy performing administrative tasks? Then this job as customer service worker is the job for you!

Furthermore you will receive a salary from € 16,13 gross per hour as a customer service worker! 🤑

What we offer
- Earn € 16,13 gross per hour!
- Travel expense reimbursement!
- Nice team! 🥳
- Opportunity for a permanent contract!
- Pension from day one!
- Fun team-building activities!

Who you are
As customer service worker you offer customers a listening ear. You enthusiastically assist everyone as a customer service worker! You are patient and approach problem-solving proactively. Experience with customer service and logistics is a plus! You actively engage with the customer and assist them where necessary. You speak English fluently. Being on call 4 / 5 times a year in thte weekend is no problem for you! The work hours are from 09:00 - 17:30 or from 09:30 - 18:00.

What will you do
You park your car or bike in the parking lot and swipe yourself in with your badge! You grab a cup of coffee and head to your desk. You check your email and answer incoming calls. At 10:00, there’s a team meeting to ensure everyone is on the same page. The latest updates are discussed, and then everyone gets back to work! 👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻

The day is roughly 40% customer service and 60% logistical administration. You provide top-notch service to customers by phone or email. You offer information about orders, deliveries, products, and other questions. You follow up on complaints and enter orders! Essentially as a customer service worker you are truly the face of the organization.

After the day is done you log off. Then say goodbye to your colleagues and head home. See you tomorrow! 👋🏽

As a Cleanroom Operator, you play an important role in maintaining the quality of high-tech products used in industries such as semiconductors and electronics. You will work in a controlled cleanroom environment where accuracy, safety, and quality are essential.

Your daily tasks include:

- Cleaning high-tech components according to cleanroom procedures and work instructions.
- Performing assembly work using hand tools and technical drawings.
- Inspecting products and carrying out quality measurements.
- Preparing and cleaning metal frames and packaging materials according to protocol.
- Reporting deviations and registering quality findings in the production system.
- Reading and following technical drawings and work instructions accurately.
- Keeping your workplace clean, safe, and organized according to cleanroom standards.

Working hours

You will work from Monday to Friday in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Evening shift: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts. Overtime on Saturdays or Sundays is paid at 150% when applicable.

Required

- Good command of the English language.
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions.
- Technical insight or experience within a production environment.
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Living in or within travelling distance of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, or Valkenswaard.

Preferred

- Experience working in a cleanroom environment.
- Experience with assembly work or high-tech production.

Are you looking for a logistics job with the chance of a permanent contract? Do you want to receive your salary every week? Are you physically strong and enjoy active work? If so, keep reading – this could be the right job for you!

As a warehouse employee in the Shipping team you are responsible for order picking, packing and picking of products, maintaining the warehouse and keeping track of inventory. The work instructions are in English, you follow them as correctly as possible. In addition, you are a team player and willing to support other teams when necessary. Together with your team you ensure that you meet the daily demand and quality. This is a full-time job, you will work from Monday to Friday starting at 09.00 AM until 17.30 PM.

In addition to an attractive salary starting at €2,650 gross per month, we offer:

- Weekly salary payments.
- 8% vacation allowance and 25 vacation days (full-time).
- Travel allowance.
- Participation in the pension fund from day one.

Where will you work?
Super Micro is a world leader in IT products. The servers are built in Den Bosch, where they have their own production department. After the production of the servers, they need to be shipped on time. ? Besides a nice salary, you will be compensated for your travel expenses. When the client is satisfied with you, and you with them, it is possible to get a permanent contract. Besides that you have a lot of (international) colleagues to work with.

- You work well under pressure and with deadlines;

Are you interested?
Apply quickly via the application button!

You want to work as a warehouse employee and enjoy getting things done. Heavier products, up to a maximum of 20 kilos, are no problem for you. You speak the English language fluently. Also, you are full-time available and in possession of a forklift certificate. Or willing to get one!

As a warehouse employee, you will be employed at a wholesale company with an international focus. The location where you will be working is in Helmond. It's a international, small and friendly team.
